prayerExcerpt.en-US: "God, Who called me from the world into religious life, now calls me from Portugal to India."
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: "Deus, que me chamou do mundo para a vida religiosa, chama-me agora de Portugal para a Índia."

meta.face: A Portuguese nobleman of about forty-five, deeply sun-browned by India, with a LEAN, LONG face — HIGH, sharply cut cheekbones with DEEP HOLLOWS beneath them, a NARROW, very HIGH-BRIDGED nose, large, dark, deep-set, burning eyes under strong, ARCHED black brows, a wide forehead, a firm mouth; black hair under the saffron turban-cloth; a full black beard, cut round and not too long, framing the hollow cheeks; the gaze lifted a little, ardent.
meta.basis: No portrait from life is known to us; the popular image (Wikipedia lead image) shows him bearded in a cream-and-saffron sannyasi's shawl and red cap with a crucifix and palm. The Catholic Encyclopedia says 'his dress was yellow cotton' and that he lived as a Tamil ascetic; Oriyur on the Marava coast is where he was beheaded. The lean, hollow-cheeked face is our choice, kept apart from `francis_xavier` (oval, in black) by the saffron dress and the structure.
